packageRules.description: Stay on gradle/actions v5. v6 extracts caching into gradle-actions-caching, a proprietary component governed by Gradle's separate Terms of Use (https://gradle.com/legal/terms-of-use/) rather than the action's MIT licence. That is a licensing decision, not a maintenance one; it was made when #18 was closed and is re-stated here because closing the bot's PR did not hold. Updates within 5.x are still wanted.
